name: Layers · Core, Melodic, Rhythmic, Nature
description: Five groups, each with its own audience rules: Core synth (Drone, Pad, Atmos, Noise), Melodic (Arp, Bells, Shimmer, two melodies), Rhythmic (Pulse, Sub), Nature samples (Stream, Rain, Garden) and the Gong (a three-person vote that ends the show: three strikes while everything fades out).
